h: Antonio Conte reportedly in talks over Manchester United job and sets conditions
p: Former Chelsea manager Antonio Conte has reportedly discussed replacing Michael Carrick at Manchester United and laid out the terms he would want. Nothing has been confirmed by the club.
more: Carrick is said to be weighing action against Bruno Fernandes over his recent comments.
United are in Champions League action this week.
